name: Fushigi Dagashiya Sentendou: Fushigi Dagashiya-banashi 50-sen
summary:
What is Fushigi Dagashi Shoya? The “Zenendo” is a soft dagashi candy shop that lucky people can enjoy. Each snack recommended by Akiko of the store is perfect for those worries. But if you eat it or use it. Whether you call happiness or misfortune, it's up to the person!
You can read "50 episodes", which is the perfect addition to the game original. The game original episodes that are familiar with dagashi and new dagashi snacks, are fun and playable with a vertical writing sentence, pictures and sounds like reading a book
